verdict.rationale: Probes confirm Mastra Code publishes an llms.txt at code.mastra.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200), with a product description aimed at agents. They also confirm agent-friendly markdown versions of doc pages (e.g., headless.md, HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation advertising or describing the llms.txt/markdown docs, and evidence of how complete the llms.txt coverage is (e.g., a full-content variant).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
